meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 回复像电报一样精简,省时省钱。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果更想看要点、不想花时间读长回答。
copy.tagline_en: Make AI reply like a telegram: short, fast, cost-saving.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer brief answers and want to skip verbose AI responses.

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 的回复会变得极简,去掉寒暄、语气词等冗余,保留全部技术要点。默认 full 级,整个会话内持续;可切换 lite/ultra/文言文变体。直到你说停才恢复。
howto.when: 当你说 'caveman mode'、'talk like caveman' 等,或发 /caveman 命令时触发。默认 full 级,之后所有回复都用此风格,直到说 'stop caveman' 或 'normal mode' 才停。

say.text: caveman mode,解释 React 重渲染原因。
say.note: 触发后默认用 full 级回复。

say.text: /caveman ultra 讲解数据库连接池。
say.note: 切换 ultra 级,回复更短。
退出模式,恢复普通风格。

howto.what_en: Enabled: Claude answers in ultra-terse style, cuts fluff, keeps all technical substance. Default 'full' level persists for session. Can switch lite/full/ultra/wenyan. Lasts until user says stop.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', etc., or /caveman command. Default full. Lasts until 'stop caveman' or 'normal mode'.

say_en.text: caveman mode, explain why React re-renders.
